name: Landscape in the Style of Dong Yuan and Juran
material: hanging scroll, ink with white pigment on silk
summary: Towering peaks and unfolding ranges are piled up and overlaid with layer after layer of brushwork to give an overall dense, dark, and even melancholic effect.
